scope: Accelerate dynamic tint contrast calculations with an exact 16-bit RGB luminance lookup.

checks.command: Compare the original and optimized luminance for all 65536 channel levels, permuted independently across RGB. Check extended RGB, HSL, CMYK and invalid colors.
Benchmark 1400 mixed translucent and opaque contrast decisions with 15 samples each. The median fell from 76.46 ms to 30.13 ms across three runs and resulting RGBA hashes matched.
pytest tests/test_launcher_presets.py::test_control_center_glass_regions: both native control glass probes passed.

coverage_limits: CPU contrast workload on the local Qt 6 build. Whole-session FPS depends on the scene and renderer.
